m01:room.title: Bit Integrity Bay
m01:room.job: Read the vault's status word, and check that it came through clean.

m02:room.title: Compression Workshop
m02:room.job: Pick how to shrink each file, and time the send over the last cable.

m03:room.title: Telemetry Audit Loft
m03:room.job: Work out how often calls fail, and sort the call records into groups.

m04:room.title: Algorithm Control Room
m04:room.job: Trace the new scheduler by hand, one time slot at a time.

m05:room.title: Abstraction Foundry
m05:room.job: Trace the shared power-limit procedure, and see how each tower should call it.

m06:room.title: Logic Validation Hall
m06:room.job: Find out what the clinic gate's test really does, and pick a fix.

m07:room.title: Protocol Exchange
m07:room.job: Split dispatch's message into packets, and send it over paths that keep changing.

m08:room.title: Redundancy Switchhouse
m08:room.job: Find out if the clinic stays connected when one piece of gear fails.

m09:room.title: Compute Dispatch Shed
m09:room.job: Find how much faster four workers sort the damage reports, with the security step kept.

m10:room.title: Security Operations Vault
m10:room.job: Decide how much to trust a login, and what it should be allowed to do.

m11:room.title: Clinical Data Exchange
m11:room.job: Trace the dispatch list, then choose what private data dispatch should get.

m12:room.title: Service Equity Observatory
m12:room.job: Find each group's delivery rate, and check every group against the floor.

m13:room.title: Runtime Diagnostics Annex
m13:room.job: Count the duplicate filter's checks, and pick a filter that fits the window.

m14:room.title: North Head Verification House
m14:room.job: Check records with a checksum, and find one record fast in the sorted log.

m15:room.title: Coastal Network Command
m15:room.job: Trace the restoration gate, and test the alert floor with text backup.
